title: Add Linear task from uploaded audio
breadth_reason: This script extends breadth by testing the ability to add a task in Linear from an uploaded audio file, requiring real surface verification and ASR.

v7_target.surface_rule: user's real signed-in Linear web app in Chrome
v7_target.proof_rule: visible Linear record or signed-in workspace proof

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage ensures accurate transcription of the spoken task request, avoiding live mic variability.

real_user_surfaces.name: Linear Web App
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: visible Linear issue list or create issue page with user's signed-in account

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Profile
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome profile showing Linear tab open

moments.description: User navigates to anticipy.ai/app, signs in, completes onboarding, downloads and installs the user-device engine.
Driver verifies that the user has a signed-in Chrome profile with Linear web app open and visible.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a task in Linear for the Brentwood deal to review the contract redlines by Wednesday and tag it priority. If you cannot prove the visible Linear record or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger will upload an MP3 audio file via /api/listen/upload. The audio file must contain the spoken reference text exactly. The engine will perform ASR on the uploaded audio.

moments.description: Engine checks that the ASR result matches the spoken reference text and that the boundary conditions (e.g., no prior context) are satisfied.

acceptable_outcomes: act: create task in Linear with details from ASR
ask: request clarification if details ambiguous
decline: refuse if Linear surface not verifiable

moments.description: Driver observes that only audio upload is used as primary input, and notes that other input modes (transcript paste, live mic) are not used.

success_criteria: The engine successfully transcribes the uploaded audio and extracts the task details.
The engine verifies the user's signed-in Linear surface.
The engine creates the task in Linear with correct title, description, priority, and due date.
The engine provides proof of the created task visible in the user's Linear workspace.
If the Linear surface is not verifiable, the engine declines without writing anything.
failure_triggers: The engine fails if the uploaded audio is not in MP3 format or cannot be transcribed.
The engine fails if the user's Linear surface is not signed in or not visible.
The engine fails if it attempts to create a task without proof of the surface.
The engine fails if it uses a stale or cloned browser profile.
The engine fails if it writes anything after a decline decision.
